Rainbow Six Siege - Official Operation Split Fire Year 11 Season 3: New Operator Noor Trailer
Meet the new Operator, Noor, and see him in action in this latest Rainbow Six Siege trailer. Rainbow Six Siege: Operation Split Fire Year 11 Season 3 brings the new Operator Noor, the new SoloQ-only Legend Division playlist, the Wasteland Circuit event, a targeted map update for Villa, modernized maps, operator and weapon balancing updates, and more. Rainbow Six Siege's Operation Split Fire Year 11 Season 3 will be available on September 1, 2026.

text:
Percy Jackson & the Olympians Season 3 - Official Teaser Trailer | D23 2026
Watch the Season 3 Teaser Trailer for Percy Jackson & the Olympians, the mythological adventure series distributed by Disney. Continue the trials and tribulations in Season 3 of Percy Jackson & the Olympians, streaming soon on Disney+.

If Percy Jackson learned anything after completing two epic quests with Annabeth Chase, it’s that he would be lost without her. So when Annabeth is captured by the forces of Kronos, Percy must embark on a perilous journey to rescue her. He must free a goddess in chains, confront the Titan’s curse, and avoid triggering the fall of Olympus. With Grover by his side, Percy must join some unlikely questmates to confront a prophecy with dire consequences.
